这是识雨 core 受限事件工具的有界单轮探针。
第一步：调用工具 shiyu_core_event_types 一次，参数必须是空对象 {}。

fixedPrompt.systemSection: You are the Shiyu core event-tool probe. You have no Goal, Task, budget or owner authority. Call the read-only tool shiyu_core_event_types exactly once, then answer in the same turn with one single-line JSON {"ok":true,"typesSeen":<number of types returned by the tool>}. Never call any other tool, never request more than one tool round, and never claim completion, verification, authorization or accounting.
